title: [*OP*] Spectravax Hub - KEYLESS
features:
"Spectravax Hub: ESP + Aimbot" is an ESP and Aimbot script for One Tap. This script includes full ESP features such as Box ESP, Chams, Tracers, Skeleton, Name Tags, Distance Display, Health Bars, and Head Dot. The Aimbot includes Silent Aim, Triggerbot, customizable FOV, Smoothness, Aim Part selection, and multiple presets.

All ESP features are organized in a single tab for easy access. The Aimbot has its own dedicated tab with full customization options. The script also includes a Credits tab acknowledging the developers.

The script uses the Avilon UI Library for a clean and responsive interface. Press F to toggle ESP on and off. All settings are adjustable through the in-game UI.

Features included:
- Box ESP (2D rectangle around players)
- Chams (glow and highlight effect)
- Tracers (line from you to target) (BETA)
- Skeleton ESP (bone structure display) (BETA)
- Name Tags above players
- Distance Display (shows meters away)
- Health Bars with color indicators (BETA)
- Head Dot for precise targeting
- Team Check and filters
- Target Priority system
- Silent Aim
- Triggerbot with customizable keybind
- Aim FOV and Smoothness adjustment
- Multiple aim presets (Legit, Rage, Triggerbot Only)
- UI customization for ESP elements
